text:
elaine: Hey team — first quick pass on the launch post draft is in: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1H4n-copy-draft (please use suggest mode). Need signoff on hero angle, the benchmark callouts, and webinar routing by EOD. Can everyone scan for anything that will block legal or webinar ops? :pray:

mike: jumping in — looks good overall. two notes: split CTAs between 'try hosted API' and 'request enterprise trial' so we don't leak enterprise flows to self-serve users. also we should add a short blurb about cost per 1k tokens for the benchmark example. :+1:

elaine: good call on CTAs. mike — can you drop a quick snippet for the CTA mapping so we can hand to web/dev? ideally JSON we can feed to the landing template.

mike: sure — sample mapping below, feel free to copy into the CMS:
```
{
  "cta_variant_A": {"label":"Try Redwood API — Free Tier","href":"/signup?utm_campaign=launch&variant=try"},
  "cta_variant_B": {"label":"Request Dedicated Demo","href":"/enterprise/demo?utm_campaign=launch"}
}
```

sara: looks tidy. on benchmarks — we need to be careful with absolute latency claims. can we change "sub-50ms" to "median latency under 60ms in our hosted benchmark (see test harness)"? legal prefers median/interquartile language.

prashant: +1 to sara. actual numbers from the perf bench (private repo) are: median=58ms, p95=120ms for 2048 tokens on rtx-a100-80gb equivalent. we can say "median ~58ms" but prefer the phrasing sara suggested. also we should include a short note about test harness: `tests/bench/launch/README.md` and link to the public benchmark table.

elaine: ok we'll phrase as "median latency ~58ms (p95 120ms) in Redwood-hosted benchmark; see methodology link" — prashant pls paste the methodology link you mentioned and I'll tuck it under the benchmark callout.

prashant: methodology link: https://perf.redwood-inference/internal/benchmarks/launch-method.md (internal). I'll DM ops to get a sanitized public excerpt for the doc.

jordan: webinar ops question — after the demo webinar we plan to route leads to HubSpot list 'Launch Webinar - Attendees'. who owns the HubSpot flow to add the two CTA segments (try vs enterprise)? @mike? Also do we have a follow-up email template?

mike: I can own the HubSpot setup. follow-up email exists in drafts: https://app.hubspot.com/drafts/launch-webinar-followup. two templates: 1) self-serve (trial + quickstart link) 2) enterprise (sales rep intro + contact link). I'll wire the routing: attendees -> if clicked enterprise CTA -> enterprise SDR queue, else -> marketing nurture.

elaine: perfect. legal check — @sara are there any flagged phrases? also need brand signoff on the hero image.

sara: legal is ok with the current language once we use "median" phrasing. one request: remove the sentence that says "no tradeoffs in quality" — too absolute. brand: we should use the new hero illustration pack (assets/redwood/illustrations/2026/launch-hero.svg). reach out to design for export sizes.

content-bot: Reminder: editorial checklist not completed — SEO meta, OG image, alt text for hero. See checklist: https://wiki.redwood-inference/marketing/editorial-checklist

elaine: noted — I'll run SEO pass tomorrow morning. final asks before EOD: prashant to provide public bench excerpt or greenlight for phrasing, mike to drop CTA mapping into CMS and own HubSpot routing, sara to confirm legal language tweak, design to export hero in 3 sizes. If no objections I'll merge the doc by 5pm and schedule publish for 10am PT next Thursday.

mike: done — CTA mapping PR opened: https://cms.redwood-inference/pull/452 (still needs review). HubSpot routing scheduled for tomorrow AM.

prashant: I'll DM ops now for the sanitized benchmark excerpt; should have it by 3pm.

sara: legal approved the median wording. removed the "no tradeoffs" line in suggestions. :white_check_mark:

elaine: amazing — thanks all. tagging @design in the doc for hero export. we'll reconvene if the benchmark text changes. :rocket:
